Static screenshots do not prove payment, secure-storage, NFC, or background behavior.
The restored VoiceOver "Caution. " prefix on iOS is a code change and appears in no image.
Android TalkBack semantics { error(...) } and the InlineNotice polite live region are not visible in a screenshot.
iOS 26.6 was the newest stable release at capture time; its simulator runtime was not installed, so 26.5 (23F77) was used by explicit choice.
Android 17 / API 37 was still beta at capture time and was excluded; API 36 is the newest stable image.
Catalog surfaces render components directly and do not prove the real screens' state wiring.
